name: San Mateo County Pregnancy, Children and Families
description: San Mateo County Health's Pregnancy, Children and Families services offer prenatal support, home visiting, nutrition, and child health programs to support healthy pregnancies and child development for families throughout the county.
fullDescription: San Mateo County Health's Pregnancy, Children and Families services offer prenatal support, home visiting, nutrition, and child health programs to support healthy pregnancies and child development for families throughout the county.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free home visiting (Nurse-Family Partnership, Healthy Families San Mateo County, Promoting First Relationships)
- Black Infant Health program
- Help getting prenatal care for Medi-Cal-eligible pregnant women
- WIC nutrition program and breastfeeding support
- California Children's Services (CCS) for children with certain medical conditions
- Oral health program for young children on Medi-Cal
- Lead poisoning prevention and parenting classes
- Services in your native language
howToGetIt: Call (650) 573-2501 for program information. Services are free for families on Medi-Cal and on a sliding fee scale for other San Mateo County residents.
